primaryObjective: Determine whether an independently releasable projection encoding can reduce measured Analysis startup transfer or cold spatial latency by at least 10% without changing any event, estimator, evidence gate, or decoded value.
hypothesis: At least one currently immutable JSON projection contains enough repeated structure for a deterministic encoding prototype to improve compressed transfer or cold decode latency by 10% while retaining byte-accounted, value-exact decoder parity and all scientific safeguards.

inScope: fresh desktop and constrained transfer, fetch, decode, and first-use baselines
one bounded encoding prototype for the highest-cost eligible immutable projection
deterministic decoded-value parity and manifest-integrity checks
deployment only if a preregistered performance metric improves by at least 10% with no material regression
outOfScope: canonical event mutation or scientific estimator changes
lossy numeric quantization, dropped provenance, or changed null and sentinel semantics
broad compression cleanup without a measured user-facing gain
overwriting any existing immutable R2 release
promotion based only on local file-size reduction

requiredFields: frozen source projection manifest and hashes
desktop and constrained fetch and decode timings
estimators: median and p95 fetch-plus-decode latency over bounded repeated profiles
negativeControls: null, sentinel, extreme-value, and provenance-field parity
readinessContract.uncertaintyTreatment: Report transfer, fetch, decode, and render phases separately. Do not attribute network variance to encoding, and do not combine incompatible cold and warm measurements.
readinessContract.suppressionPolicy: Reject deployment unless one preregistered user-facing metric improves by at least 10%, all decoded and scientific outputs remain exact, and no existing release, accessibility, performance, or provenance gate regresses.

releaseGates: fresh baseline recorded before prototype selection
deterministic encoded artifact and value-exact decoder parity
at least 10% improvement in one preregistered user-facing performance metric
no scientific output, provenance, missingness, sentinel, or uncertainty change
desktop and constrained browser QA with zero console errors
identical frozen Pages package preview to production and tested rollback
stopConditions: no eligible projection shows a credible path to at least 10% user-facing improvement
an encoding improvement requires lossy values, provenance loss, or scientific output changes
performance variance prevents a stable 10% result
rights, integrity, accessibility, or existing release gates would weaken
